control.$description: Small interactive controls — inputs at xs/sm, badges, pills, tooltips, kbd. The quiet 4px chip.

surface.$description: The default surface corner — inputs at md/lg, dropdowns, popovers, panels, alerts, snackbars. The most-used role; re-point this to make a theme flatter or rounder overall.

card.$description: Content containers — cards, collapsibles. Separate from `surface` so a theme can round its cards without rounding every menu.

overlay.$description: Things that float above the page — dialogs, confirm dialogs, the command palette, entity search.

pill.$description: Fully rounded — avatars, progress bars, filter pills, breadcrumb pills, the back-to-top button.
